name: bozzies/playlist-player
title: Playlist player
description: Astro's interactive playlist player — the .pp module with player controls, progress bar, and scrollable track list. Verbatim from ~/boswell-poc/src/components/PlaylistPlayer.astro. Track metadata (title / artist / year / duration / audio URL) is stored on the block; front-end JS wires up play/pause, seeking, keyboard control.
